rework.proof: 5 recordings of the 128K release on rework v128 (bot walks: mirror1 6,013 / mirror2 6,330 frames in room 40 'DOUBLE TROUBLE!' through the game's own room skip, walk1-3 12,008 / 12,015 / 12,163 frames from the start): every hook event identical: 8,182 player plots (8,779 sprite pictures pixel-perfect), 8,686 erases, 18,603 ISR, 130 wipes and 90 boxes hiding Dizzy, 1,022 mirror plots and 989 mirror erases (the original routine on the patched-screen model against the copy); mirror1, mirror2, walk2 IDENTICAL; walk1 and walk3 FAILED on 5 of 171,382 pixel tests (cells 0x48C5 / 0x4DC6 in the start room, PC 0x9B78 / 0x9B7D), where the original's eraser XOR leaves a hole or a ghost pixel in an object drawn over Dizzy (Dean's 48K build has the same design); 2 player plots in mirror1 differ only in register B (the original plots over the mirrored Dizzy's pixels), dead by a 20,000-instruction run with either value; 8 negative controls detected; clock matrix 7 hook sites x 4 incoming clocks = 28 cases PASS, a forced 3.5 MHz exit detected; ROM paths pass; start-up tail never read before written; R never read; hook stack low water 0x9C5F (code ends 0x9C32)
rework.note: Jon Attree's Prince of the Yolkfolk 128K rework (2026-11-06): engine yolk128 (engines.py: the 128K snapshot), Dean's tid_mirror build (build.TidPatch altrom, dizzy6.layout / relocated_copy: used, not copied) on the 128K release so the AY music plays; whole alt ROM image 1 with his hooks at 0x386E and the mirror copy at 0x2000; the mirror erase through NEXTREG 0x51,24 (RAM page 24, the alt ROM's copy source); tail in the undo buffer 0x5C00; printer buffer put back after NEXLOAD; plot hook at 28 MHz, incoming speed restored; a 128K TID verifier with the mirror events. Recordings: bot walks on SkoolKit's C simulator (the mirror ones poke the game's room-skip flag 0x77C2 = 0 into their first snapshot).
